title: Bipartisan 'Great American AI Act' draft would preempt state laws and require frontier safety frameworks
summary: Reps. Obernolte and Trahan released a 269-page draft requiring large frontier developers to publish safety frameworks, report critical incidents and undergo audits, while preempting state frontier-AI laws for three years; unions opposed it.
reason: Proposed federal oversight (up) paired with state-law preemption; discussion draft so signal.

title: Nvidia releases open-weight Nemotron 3 Ultra (550B MoE)
summary: Nvidia shipped Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550B-parameter open-weight mixture-of-experts model, on Hugging Face and its NIM platform.
reason: Mid/large open-weights release, reportedly still behind Kimi K2.6.
